notes: Validated against Serganov et al. Nature 2006 (doi:10.1038/nature04740). 2HOJ: E. coli thiM riboswitch with native TPP ligand (2.50 Å). Same overall recognition mode as 2GDI: aminopyrimidine arm stacks in pyrimidine sensor helix (G78-G40 stack); thiazole ring van der Waals contact with G72 sugar but not base-paired. Pyrophosphate sensor helix contacts via two Mg²⁺ ions; C73-G91 pair in backbone proximity of pyrophosphate tail.
